[Section] Propaganda Techniques ::: 12. Thought-terminating cliché.
[source_id=37] Words or phrases that discourage critical thought and meaningful discussion about a given topic. They are typically short and generic sentences that offer seemingly simple answers to complex questions or that distract attention away from other lines of thought BIBREF18.
